pages.title: Ten Shadows
pages.text: Cries to Mahoraga when he gets a paper cut.

Ten Shadows is an inherited technique, passed down through generations of the Zenin clan.$(br2)Abilities $(li)$(k:attack): Punch$(li)$(k:use): Roundhouse$(li)$(k:boundless.ability_one): Summon $(l:techniques/shadow#kuro)$(t:Go to Kuro's Page)Kuro$(/l)$(/t)$(li)$(k:boundless.ability_two): Summon $(l:techniques/shadow#shiro)$(t:Go to Shiro's Page)Shiro$(/l)$(/t)$(li)$(k:boundless.ability_three): Summon $(l:techniques/shadow#gama)$(t:Go to Gama's Page)Gama$(/l)$(/t)

Kuro specialises in heavy damage and raw attack power. He deals high damage, and applies bleeding to enemies. $(br2)Kuro has the following base stats:$(li)Health: 435$(li)Damage: 15$(li)Cursed Energy Usage: 200

Although not as strong as Kuro, Shiro is excellent for tracking and pairs nicely with him for additional damage. Hand Shiro an item and it will find you a duplicate within a given range. $(br2)Shiro has the following base stats:$(li)Health: 435$(li)Damage: 10$(li)Cursed Energy Usage: 200

Gama specializes in utility. You can grapple by right clicking when mounted, and leap higher by charging his jump. Gama does not deal damage directly; instead, his pull combo brings the enemy towards him, and applies a 2 second stun, allowing you a chance to deal damage. $(br2)Gama has the following base stats:$(li)Health: 200$(li)Cursed Energy Usage: 300
